name: Alex Barry
title: Psychologist
description: Alex has experience working with young and older adults who are seeking support for the impacts of sexual trauma, abuse and neglect, family and intimate partner violence, relationship and intimacy issues. Alex's therapeutic approach is integrative, drawing on a range of interventions including EMDR, cognitive behavioural therapy, schema therapy, internal family systems, mindfulness and somatic based practice. Alex practices from a place that is deeply person-centred, neuro-affirming, sex positive, and LGBTQIA+ inclusive.
specialties: Complex Trauma, PTSD, Sexual Abuse/Assault, Sexual Problems, Sexuality & Gender, EMDR, Schema Therapy, IFS

name: Allison Conyer
title: Psychologist
description: Allison has counselled individuals managing anxiety, depression, trauma, abuse, low self-esteem, body issues, perfectionism and more. Allison employs an integrative approach drawing upon cognitive behaviour therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, schema therapy, brief psychodynamic psychotherapy, mindfulness, trauma-informed recovery-based practice, and play therapy. Also works with couples and families.
specialties: PTSD, trauma, anxiety, eating disorders, Schema Therapy, Sex Therapy, Couples Therapy

name: Amy Bortz
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Amy (she/her) is a compassionate and LGBTQIAP+ friendly clinician who works with clients aged 16+. Amy tends to utilise skills and techniques from various treatment modalities, including Schema Therapy, ACT, CBT, Mindfulness, DBT and Compassion-Focused Therapy. Clinical interests include gender dysphoria, LGBTQIA+ and non-monogamy/polyamory.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, Gender Dysphoria, Non-Monogamy/Polyamory, Eating Disorders, Schema Therapy

name: Belinda Pacella
title: Clinical Psychologist, Board-Approved Supervisor
description: Belinda values building an authentic therapeutic relationship where people feel safe to explore parts of their inner world in a non-judgemental and empathic space. She adopts an integrative approach mainly informed by relational and emotion-focussed frameworks, particularly Intensive Short Term Dynamic Psychotherapy (ISTDP). Clinical interests include trauma and adjustment, complex trauma and intergenerational trauma.
specialties: Complex trauma, Intergenerational trauma, Anxiety, Depression, ISTDP

name: Brigid Blanckenberg
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Brigid is an accredited EMDR therapist and Internal Family Systems therapist (Level 1), and she also draws upon Schema Therapy, CBT and ACT. She has experience supporting adults and adolescents with anxiety, mood difficulties, stress, PTSD, complex trauma, relationship issues, identity and body image. She also has a strong commitment to working inclusively with members of the LGBTIQ+ community.
specialties: PTSD, Trauma, LGBTQIA+ Affirmative Therapy, EMDR, IFS / Parts Work, Schema Therapy

name: Chiara Killey
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Chiara is a neurodivergent Clinical Psychologist who practices under the neuro-affirming paradigm and sees adults for therapy and autism/ADHD assessment. She uses a tailored approach incorporating CBT, ACT, DBT, interpersonal therapy, narrative therapy, schema therapy and other evidence-based modalities. She is a neurodiversity advocate and proudly supports individuals of all genders and sexual orientations.
specialties: Autism and ADHD assessment, LGBTIQA+, Schema Therapy, Depression, Anxiety

name: Dr Christine Deftereos
title: Clinical Psychotherapist, Psychoanalyst & Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Christine is a Clinical Psychotherapist, Psychoanalyst & Accredited Mental Health Social Worker with specialized accreditations in Complex Trauma, Acute Stress, Post Traumatic Stress Disorders, Intergenerational Trauma, and EMDR. She has worked with individuals who have survived sexual assault, childhood abuse and neglect, family and domestic violence, dissociative states and disorders, substance misuse and disordered eating.
specialties: Complex Trauma, PTSD, Intergenerational Trauma, EMDR, Dissociative disorders, Sexual assault
